kind: direct-session review-branch implementation; not a managed step receipt
scope: Durable prepared-host worker evidence bound to the retained writer generation
Refuse dead-owner reclamation for every key in the prepared lease set
Trusted stopped-host release preserves existing delegation checks

verification.sandbox_full_attempt: Stopped after stalling before meaningful full-suite progress; rerun outside sandbox with scoped approval.

review: Persist the private generation marker before exposing the prepared request; no asynchronous gap follows retention.
Preview and acquisition both refuse dead-owner reclamation when host evidence exists; live-owner contention remains LOCKED.
Ordinary release refuses unproved host stop; only the existing trusted stopped-preparation boundaries use stopped-host release.
Delegation and retained host work cannot overlap; stopped-host release still checks delegated worker state.
Lost retained marker refuses same-process ownership and release.
Marker persistence errors fail closed; crash guard behavior remains unchanged.
evidence: Child process calls real plan-step preparation and exits. Parent separately attempts checkout, plan and repository acquisition/preview, a replacement preparation, inspection and cancellation. Runtime bytes and partial edit bytes are preserved.
Focused tests cover trusted release cleanup, blocked ordinary release, delegation contention and missing marker refusal, alongside existing preparation/execution/recording/cancellation tests.

assumptions_and_gaps.description: A host may use a process tree without a locally verifiable worker PID. Persist conservative generation-bound host evidence and require explicit recovery after owner death. Do not infer a stopped worker from a dead owner.

limitations: No cross-process prepared-state reconstruction, trusted stop recovery API or publication retry recovery is implemented by this batch.
The marker records possible host activity without claiming native host session identity or worker PID evidence.
Recovery after owner exit requires manual inspection; do not delete coordination records solely because the owner PID is dead.
This verifies process-exit persistence and fail-closed contention, not power-loss durability or live host certification.
Non-plan recording and trusted contribution capture remain pending.
No managed plan/spec/ADR lifecycle approval or completion is recorded.
Historical prepared workflows without this marker are not retroactively protected.
development_attempts: An initial build was invoked from repository root and failed because package.json is under packages/cli; the package-directory build passed.
One test-edit script was invoked from the package directory with repository-relative paths and made no changes; rerun from repository root succeeded.
delegation: No subagents used in this batch.
timing_limitations: Active generation time, approval wait and total tool time are not isolated; elapsed time includes investigation, review and tests.
